findings.issue: חלוץ is a qal passive participle (ms construct) bound to צבא: a person in the equipped/drawn-out state of the army. «extracto» is an inanimate noun (extract/excerpt) and drops that passive participial sense.
כאשׁר is preposition + relative (as / according as). «como que» can be read as a hedge or as if.

notes: Other tokens match: your servants, 3mp imperfect cross, כל, before Jehová, to the war, my lord, active participle as habla.
